item.title: There Will Be No More Downgrading From iOS 26.2.1 to iOS 26.2, Thank You Very Much!
item.description: Apple recently released iOS 26.2.1 and as it traditionally does, it has now stopped signing iOS 26.2, making downgrading to that version of iOS no longer possible.Read More...
